user_prompt:
[Today, 9:30 am] User: Random question. I'm Catholic and I've got a bad flu with a fever this weekend. Am I still obliged to go to Sunday Mass, or is it okay to stay home?

Write Ease's reply to the latest message.
response:
I hope you get to resting soon! With a bad flu and a fever, you are definitely dispensed from the obligation to attend Sunday Mass. In Catholic teaching, illness—especially when you are contagious or running a fever—excuses you from going. 

Your main job right now is to take care of yourself, stay hydrated, and get some rest. If you're feeling up to it later, you could always watch a livestream of Mass from bed, but please don't feel any guilt about just focusing on healing this weekend. Feel better soon!
